decision: Add BF16-embedding joint controls before development selection
reason: Isolate embedding precision from backbone/head compression; preserve a conservative world-free deployment control. Initial matched smoke showed int8 embeddings7/10 versus B168/10.

decision: Test physical 2/3-bit compression below the four-bit frontier
reason: Extend compression-boundary coverage using pinned gradient-free HQQ proximal quantization and current GemLite BF16 kernels; preserve checkpoint, calibration, states and final threshold. No HQQ+ fine-tuning.

decision: Add up to four matched smoke boundary rounds before 100-trial selection
reason: Mild and aggressive endpoint trials leave intermediate registered head/channel/depth settings untested. Probe between observed passing/failing settings using robot outcomes; keep ranking criteria separate and record nonmonotonic outcomes.

decision: Prime observation-bank input shapes before final warmed timing for every configuration, including B16
reason: Fused low-bit kernels compile/autotune per input shape. Priming prevents setup for later task shapes entering warmed inference metrics. Record its wall time and allocated/reserved memory separately. Original 20 warmup and 500 predictions x3 repetitions remain, with noise seeds restarted per repetition.

decision: Remove the arbitrary 45-family endpoint cap before selection is created
reason: The expanded matrix has 59 potential remaining standalone families. Alphabetical truncation could omit packed SparseGPT, dynamic W8A8 and Wanda comparisons. Screen all candidates and smoke-test one remaining endpoint per family before boundary probes and 100-trial selection.

decision: Verify actual model tensors and non-tensor quantization metadata across development, size and confirmation
reason: Freeze canonical packed tensor payload, aliases, subclass layouts and calibrated QuantVLA output-balancing scalars. Recipe/source hashes alone do not verify reconstructed model values. No development selection or reserved outcomes exist.

decision: Add a controlled mild-pruning plus vocabulary-compaction joint configuration before development selection
reason: Mild structural NF4 deployment scored 7/10 with int8 embeddings; unpruned compact NF4 scored 8/10. Existing compact/pruned configuration changes channels from 12.5% to 25% and removed layers from one to two, scoring 5/10. Test compaction while holding the milder pruning and quantization fixed.
scheduled: after structural boundary probes, before 100-trial development selection

decision: Test vocabulary compaction at both viable mixed-precision decoder settings
reason: The NF4 decoder plus HQQ2 vision/action-MLP combination completed 8/10 matched smoke trials at 1.377 GB allocated peak. The HQQ3 decoder standalone completed 7/10; its mixed combination is undergoing rollouts and has lower stored tensor bytes than the NF4/HQQ2 combination. Compare compact embeddings at each precision without changing pruning, calibration or inference. These are task-suite-specific deployments, not general vocabulary models.
scheduled: post-boundary joint screening and matched smoke, before 100-trial selection

decision: Test up to four joint configurations from observed pruning boundaries before development selection
reason: Uniform mild/aggressive pruning does not test the strongest passing individual component settings. After structural boundary rollouts, register text-MLP-only, all-channel, all-head and all-depth combinations with compact-vocabulary NF4 deployment. Choose only from matched completed smoke outcomes, preserve ranking criteria, and measure joint success rather than assuming composition. Record component evidence and immutable recipe hashes before tests.
candidate_count_change: up to four generated after component boundary probes

decision: Complete untested strongest deployment-ablation endpoints before development selection
reason: Observed screen-memory scheduling selected solver2, horizon5 and replanning5 instead of minimum-count1; visual-token grouping selected only magnitude75. Preserve the existing family scheduling manifest and measure solver1, action-horizon1, replanning1 and uniform75 task outcomes explicitly.

decision: Measure the intermediate embodied-conditioning token setting before development selection
reason: Eight embodied tokens lost all eight matched baseline successes; 24 tokens retained them. The structural boundary scheduler covers channels, heads and layers but not token counts. Test the already-screened 16-token recipe to bracket this measured failure without changing calibration, checkpoint or reserved states.
scheduled: post-boundary supplemental rollouts before development selection

decision: Test compiled TorchAO W8A8 and matched BF16 Linear controls before development selection
reason: Eager action W8A8 screened at 942.8 ms versus B16 74.1 ms. Pinned TorchAO quant_api explicitly says intended deployment uses torch.compile for fusion and mixed GEMM kernels. Preserve eager results and add scoped compiled Linear deployment comparisons rather than attributing eager overhead to the quantization algorithm. Whole-policy fusion is not tested.
scheduled: post-boundary supplemental screens and smoke, before development selection

decision: Test Triton compiled action W8A8 with a matched BF16 control before development selection
reason: Default compiled action W8A8 failed in the native integer GEMM at the seven-row action encoder. cuBLAS also restricts action interface widths. Inductor supplies Triton int32 GEMM templates; force that registered route with autotuning while retaining original shapes and weights. Preserve the failed default record. Stop and resume the runner at a candidate boundary before any development selection.
scheduled: finite screens and matched smoke before development selection

decision: Supplement preserved development selection with two matched comparisons
reason: Supplement the preserved 20-candidate development selection with a same-storage CKA action-depth variant having better matched smoke success and a lower-storage full-vocabulary HQQ3 variant excluded by peak-memory ordering. Use the same 100-state cohort and measure actual archive size after completed development runs.

decision: Register one final bounded 2x2 compression refinement round before reserved confirmation
reason: The 890.5 MB compact language-MLP candidate passes at 78/100. Standalone vision MLP, language KV-head and vision-head cuts score 83, 83 and 82; merger 75% and action-head 75% cuts fail at 76 and 69. The all-channel bundle scores 70. Test a finite 2x2 joint matrix excluding those failed merger/action-head cuts, pairing channel-only and channel-plus-head structure with measured 85/100 NF4 and 87/100 NF4/HQQ2 controls. Combined success must be measured; isolated passes do not establish compatibility.

decision: Freeze three compressed configurations before any reserved trials
reason: Smallest restricted-vocabulary model passing the development and memory gates; most successful restricted model (packed size breaks ties); most successful full-vocabulary model (packed size breaks ties). Deduplicate. Use development only.
